subject: Your FF Digest

disagreements.detail: High expert disagreement: rank 6-20 (std 3.06) -- highest: Mike Harmon (#5), lowest: Nathan Jahnke (#21)

news.title: Emari Demercado expected to re-sign with Cowboys
news.impact: Demercado had been competing with Tyler Goodson for the backup role. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

news.title: Jalen Coker (quad) remains on track to return in Week 6
news.impact: This confirms a previous report from Monday. He was spotted practicing on Tuesday.

news.title: Jerry Jeudy could be traded by Browns
news.impact: Jordan Schultz reported he's not sure they'll be able to get it. Jeudy will be a player to monitor closer to the trade deadline.

news.title: Blake Grupe signed by Rams
news.impact: Grupe will get an opportunity with the Rams with Harrison Mevis released.

news.title: Harrison Mevis released by Rams
news.impact: Mevis missed two field goals in Monday's loss against the Bills. The Rams signed Blake Grupe off the Jets practice squad as the corresponding move.

narrative: Dak Prescott is this week's great debate — experts have him anywhere from QB5 (Mike Harmon) to QB21 (Nathan Jahnke), a spread wide enough to make you question everything. Over in the wideout room, Ja'Marr Chase is now Questionable with an illness and Zay Flowers is Questionable with a shoulder, so keep your phone close on Sunday morning. Christian Watson is the clearest call of the bunch: he's OUT with a knee, so pivot now rather than panic later. Not a lot of certainty this week — just a lot of inactive-report refreshing.
